findings.reason: A signed spatial section concretely distinguishes the two horizontal faces, lateral face, rim edges and the upward component of the lateral outward normal. This materially clarifies the geometric input to the linked cone energy identity despite the complete independent proof.
findings.action: Added a c=1 sectional trapezium and normal arrows in final Remarks, with precise interpretation and proof-step justifications.

correction: Added only explanatory Remarks prose and a native TikZ illustration; title, all frontmatter, Statement, Facts, and Proof are unchanged.

diagram_math_checks.data: Plane x=x0+se for unit e, coordinates (s,t), c=1. Illustration uses t0=4,t1=1,t2=2.5.
diagram_math_checks.check: Because |se|=|s|, the definition of K restricts to 1<t<2.5 and |s|<4-t. Bottom endpoints are (-3,1),(3,1); top endpoints are (-1.5,2.5),(1.5,2.5). All four solid sides are precisely the section boundary.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Statement definition of K and proof step 3.1.

diagram_math_checks.check: Horizontal segments at t1,t2 are the disk sections, and sloping segments satisfy |s|=4-t. The four filled corners are E intersected with the plane, not points of the open K. Dashed lines continue |s|=4-t to (s,t)=(0,4), labeled by its space-time point (x0,t0).
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Proof steps 3.1 and 5.1; Remarks explicitly distinguishes boundary markers from open K membership.

diagram_math_checks.check: Bottom and top arrows have directions (0,-1),(0,1). The lateral arrow starts at (2.2,1.8), where s+t=4, and has direction (0.65,0.65), proportional to (1,1), which is the right-side c=1 outward normal (e,1)/sqrt(2) in space-time. It points toward increasing |s|+t. Arrow lengths are explicitly schematic, not claimed to be unit lengths.
No proof or Facts uses the figure; it is solely in Remarks. General c and all n remain as stated; explanatory prose explicitly limits the drawn slopes to c=1.
diagram_math_checks.local_justification: Unchanged Statement and Proof; added Remarks lines 118-126.
